title: M5: SMS
description:
SMS through AWS End User Messaging SMS with a toll-free number (Amazon Connect rejected as overkill; Twilio kept as fallback). Carrier registration has a lead time of weeks, so the owner-run registration task is started at the beginning of M2 even though the adapter ships last. Adds phone verification, opt-out handling, segment-aware rendering with a link to the full answer, and the only recurring floor in the design (a rented number, about 2 USD per month, created only when an organization enables SMS).

Depends on M2 for code; the registration task has no code dependency.
